what: The inspect tool (shortcut I) is defined in TOOLS array but not handled in onCellClick in editor-canvas.ts. Left-click in inspect mode falls through to paintAt() which tries to paint on the cell. Right-click (contextmenu) correctly calls inspectCell().
why: User expects inspect tool to show cell details on click, but it paints instead. This is a regression - the tool exists in UI but the click handler is missing.
how: Add an inspect case in onCellClick (editor-canvas.ts) before the paintAt fallback. The case should call inspectCell(p, x, y) to set state.inspected and trigger softRender which shows the cell panel.
acceptance:
1. Select inspect tool (I key or toolbar button)
2. Left-click a cell on the grid
3. Cell panel opens showing cell info (biome, road, floor, structure, area, sub-zone, exits, name)
4. Right-click on any tool still works as before

browser_ui.home: World Painter editor (any scope with grid)
steps: Open World Painter for a scope with has_grid=true
Select Inspect tool (I key or 🔍 Inspect button)
Left-click any cell on the grid
Observe: cell panel should open with cell details
browser_ui.reason: Inspect tool click handler missing in onCellClick
browser_ui.alt_steps: Right-click any cell on any tool - should still open cell panel
